android.desc: Scientific Calculator is a powerful Android scientific calculator with a realistic look. It is one of the few Android calculators with complex number equations support. Scientific Calculator Features: • Real equation view editor with brackets and operator priority support. • Component or polar complex entry/view mode. • Equation and result history. • 7 easy-to-use memories. • Large universal/physical/mathematical/chemical constant table. • Degrees, radians, and grads mode for trigonometric functions. • Fixed, scientific, and engineering view mode. • Easy to use with a realistic look. • Perform mathematical operations for mathematical equations. • For engineering or graphical calculations.
